subject: Optimize dict expand check, move allow check after the thresholds check (#12789)
reason: The change only reorders two pure checks in _dictExpandIfNeeded (dict.c): the dictTypeExpandAllowed call moves from before the size-threshold checks to inside the branch taken when an expand is due. The only expandAllowed implementation (dictExpandAllowed -> overMaxmemoryAfterAlloc) is side-effect-free, and expansion still happens exactly when both the thresholds pass and the allow check passes, so the expand decision is identical on both builds. This is a performance-only refactor with no observable behaviour change to test.
